stem_book: Linear momentum for an object varies as p = 3t³ + 4t². The force vs time curve for the object is (a) [F–t graph: curve from the origin, concave up] (b) [curve from the origin, concave down] (c) [horizontal line, F constant] (d) [straight line through the origin]
key: a [F–t curve: parabola starting at the origin and curving upward — F = 9t² + 8t]
work: F = dp/dt = 9t² + 8t; F(0) = 0, d²F/dt² = 18 > 0 → concave-up curve from origin = (a)
